meta.name: Such Brave Girls
meta.description:
Sisters Josie and Billie and their single mother Deb navigate life armed with nothing but poor judgement and self-esteem exclusively tied to people who couldn't care less about them. They're vain, selfish, heavily in debt, pathologically desperate for affection and bursting with misplaced, terrifying love.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 22 Nov 2023 · United Kingdom, United States of America · Language: English
Studio: A24, Various Artists · Network: BBC Three

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 not on server

videos.title: Such Happy Girls
videos.overview: Deb invites new boyfriend Dev home to meet daughters Billie and Josie whilst also hiding how troubled they are. Billie tries to win back Nicky, the reluctant love of her life.

videos.title: Such Unavailable Girls
videos.overview: Deb's determined to bond with Dev by any means necessary and finally gets to see his massive house. Billie plays hard to get with Nicky, and Josie remembers she has a boyfriend.

videos.title: Such Birthday Girls
videos.overview: Josie tries to make her birthday dinner last as long as possible. Deb thinks Dev might pay for once. Billie and Nicky's relationship is going really well...for some reason.

videos.title: Such Outdoorsy Girls
videos.overview: The gang takes to the woods, where Deb competes with a dead woman. Josie decides she's an artist, which upsets everyone. Billie welcomes a new man into her life.

videos.title: Such Friendly Girls
videos.overview: Billie and Josie go clubbing in the face of their nan's impending death. Deb is on a mission to prove therapy is useless.

videos.title: Such Daddy's Girls
videos.overview: Preparing to see their dad again, Josie writes a speech to tell him how she feels, and Billie's got newfound confidence in men. Dev has a very big question for Deb.
